text: 商务部新闻发言人何亚东在16日举行的商务部例行新闻发布会上回应推动解决安世半导体进展的有关提问时说，中荷建立开放务实的全面合作伙伴关系10多年来，双边经贸合作不断深化。7月7日，荷兰外贸与发展合作大臣舍尔茨玛访华，王文涛部长与其共同主持召开中荷经贸混委会第18次会议，就中荷、中欧经贸关系坦诚、深入交换意见。中荷双方同意，双方政府应创造良好环境，推动企业通过协商化解纠纷，保障全球半导体产供链安全稳定。(新华社)
text_en: Ministry of Commerce spokesperson He Yadong, at a regular press conference on July 16, responded to questions about progress in resolving the Nexperia Semiconductor issue, saying that since establishing an open and pragmatic comprehensive partnership over 10 years ago, bilateral economic and trade cooperation has deepened. On July 7, Dutch Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation Reinette Klever visited China, and Minister Wang Wentao co-chaired the 18th China-Netherlands Economic and Trade Joint Committee meeting, conducting frank and in-depth exchanges on China-Netherlands and China-EU economic ties. Both sides agreed that governments should create a favorable environment and promote enterprise negotiation to resolve disputes, ensuring the security and stability of the global semiconductor supply chain. (Xinhua News Agency)
